content: साधन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [साध् णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Accomplishing, effecting <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Procuring. .²3 Conjuring up (a spirit). .²4 Denoting, expressive of. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Accomplishing, effecting, performing, as in स्वार्थसाधनम्. .²2 Fulfilment, accomplishment, complete attainment of an object; प्रजार्थसाधने तौ हि पर्यायोद्यतकार्मुकौ <ls>R. 4. 16</ls>. .²3 A means, an expedient, a means of accomplishing anything; असाधना अपि प्राज्ञा बुद्धिमन्तो बहुश्रुताः . साधयन्त्यशु कार्याणि <ls>Pt. 2. 1</ls>; शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनम् <ls>Ku. 5. 33</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 5.">52</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 19</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 36</ls>, <ls n="R. 4.">62</ls>. .²4 An instrument, agent; कुठारः छिदिक्रियासाधनम् .²5 The efficient cause, source, cause in general. .²6 The instrumental case. .²7 Implement, apparatus. .²8 Appliance, materials. .²9 Matter, ingredients, substance. .²10 An army or a part thereof; व्यावृत्तं च विपक्षतो भवति यत्तत्साधनं सिद्धये <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²11 Aid, help, assistance (in general). .²12 Proof, substantiation, demonstration. .²13 The {%hetu%} or middle term in a syllogism, reason, that which leads to a conclusion; साध्ये निश्चितमन्वयेन घटितं बिभ्रत् सपक्षे स्थितिं . व्यावृत्तं च विपक्षतो भवति यत्तत् साधनं सिद्धये .. <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²14 Subduing, overcoming. .²15 Subduing by charms. .²16 Accomplishing anything by charms or magic. .²17 Healing, curing. .²18 Killing, destroying; फलं च तस्य प्रतिसाधनम् <ls>Ki. 14. 17</ls>. .²19 Conciliating, propitiating, winning over. .²20 Going out, setting forward, departure. .²21 Going after, following. .²22 Penance, self-mortification. .²23 Attainment of final beatitude. .²24 A medicinal preparation, drug, medicine. .²25 (In law) Enforcement of the the delivery of anything, or of the payment of debt, infliction of fine. .²26 A bodily organ. .²27 The penis. .²28 An udder. .²29 Wealth. .²30 Friendship. .²31 Profit, advantage. .²32 Burning a dead body. .²33 Obsequies. .²34 Killing or oxydation of metals. .²35 Proof, argument. .²36 Conflict, battle. .²37 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Instrument, agent. .²38 Making ready, preparation. .²39 Gain, acquisition. .²40 Calculation.
